title: V-block pair with clamps
description: A matched pair of hardened and ground 90° V-blocks, 45 × 40 × 35 mm, for shafts of 6 to 30 mm, with black-oxide U-clamps holding a ground test pin.
process: Milling, hardening, surface grinding; clamps cut from plate, black oxide

difficulty.rationale: A 40-segment constrained profile, 80 chamfered edges, revolve with mirror and booleans, three patterns, eight threads, four bodies, contact proofs needing careful edge naming.

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: document.check ok with its own 21 assertions, also at pin 6, 25, 30 mm and length 40, 70, 100 mm; section 1114.7925 mm2, pin centre 36.642 mm and the blocks' 0.7778 kg equal to this example's; pin on all four flanks, screws and hooks bearing, end-hole wall 2.3 mm; 93 steps, about 45 CLI calls. It threaded the crossbar 9 mm (F-056) and threaded the mirrored block separately (F-052).
